source: Public Juice Shop challenge themes + what this tool can observe without exploiting the app.

detectable_by_this_tool.label: Application reachable over HTTP without TLS
Web service listening on a local port (typically 3000)

not_detectable_nmap_nvd.label: Score Board (hidden challenge page) — application logic, not a service banner
DOM XSS — needs application testing, not CVE lookup from Nmap
SQL injection on login — needs application testing; we do not send attack payloads
Broken authentication challenges — out of scope for this correlator
